destinations.name: Kashmir
destinations.desc: Dal Lake reflections, saffron fields and Mughal gardens set against the Great Himalayan Range. Srinagar's old city, houseboats and the meadows of Gulmarg reward unhurried exploration.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.desc: Pine-scented morning walks, the Beas river rushing below and Rohtang Pass above the clouds. Manali blends adventure with mountain calm in equal measure.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.desc: Pink sandstone forts, jewelled bazaars and courtyard cafes in the heart of Rajasthan. Amber Fort at dawn and a thali dinner in a haveli courtyard are memories you'll carry home.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.desc: Golden beaches, a colonial old quarter and tables that fill up long after sunset. Goa is equally good for a hammock holiday and a week of village exploring.

destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.desc: Backwaters traced by wooden kettuvallams, tea-draped hillsides at Munnar and the living traditions of Kochi's harbour quarter. Kerala slows you down in the best possible way.

destinations.name: Udaipur
destinations.desc: A city of lakes reflecting palace walls, of rooftop dinners and horse-drawn carriages that still make sense here. Udaipur rewards those who linger.

destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.desc: Dawn on the Ganga, temple bells echoing through centuries of lanes and a city that has never stopped. Varanasi is best experienced slowly, with a local to show you its layers.

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.desc: River paths, suspension bridges and forest trails above the Ganges. Rishikesh is a gentle base for yoga, day hikes and white-water rafting with certified river guides.

destinations.name: Andaman
destinations.desc: Powder-white beaches, clear water over living coral and forest trails that reach the coast. The Andamans reward those who leave their schedule behind.

destinations.name: Darjeeling
destinations.desc: First Flush tea at dawn with Kangchenjunga above the clouds, a toy train winding through forest clearings and a hill station that still moves at its own Victorian pace.

experiences.name: Himalayan hiking
experiences.desc: A guided trail through pine forests and panoramic mountain paths above 3,000 metres.

experiences.name: Old Jaipur walk
experiences.desc: Discover hidden havelis, craft lanes and local stories with a registered guide.

experiences.name: Kerala backwater cruise
experiences.desc: Glide past palm-lined canals and village life on a traditional wooden kettuvallam.

experiences.name: Ganga sunrise ceremony
experiences.desc: A respectful, small-group boat experience for the morning Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat.

experiences.name: River rafting
experiences.desc: Feel the rush of Grade III–IV rapids on the Ganges with certified local river guides.

experiences.name: Coastal food trail
experiences.desc: Taste regional favourites — bebinca, xacuti, fresh catch — at independent neighbourhood spots.

experiences.name: Pangong Lake sunrise drive
experiences.desc: Early morning jeep drive to catch the colour-shifting waters of Pangong Tso at first light.

experiences.name: Hampi heritage walk
experiences.desc: Step through the ruins of Vijayanagara with an ASI-certified local historian guide.

experiences.name: Darjeeling tea experience
experiences.desc: Walk a working tea garden, pick leaves with a planter and end with a guided cupping session.

experiences.name: Ayurveda wellness day
experiences.desc: A full Panchakarma consultation and traditional Abhyanga massage at a Kerala Ayurveda centre.

experiences.name: Kathakali cultural evening
experiences.desc: Witness the elaborate makeup, storytelling and footwork of Kerala's classical dance-drama.

experiences.name: Udaipur lake boat ride
experiences.desc: Drift across Lake Pichola past the shimmering Jag Mandir island palace as the sun dips low.

experiences.name: Dal Lake Shikara & Floating Market
experiences.desc: Glide through the morning mist on Dal Lake, visiting floating vegetable markets and historic wooden houseboats.

experiences.name: Gulmarg Gondola & Meadow Trek
experiences.desc: Ascend to Kongdoori and Apharwat Peak on Asia's highest cable car, followed by a guided meadow hike.

experiences.name: Old Srinagar & Wazwan Food Trail
experiences.desc: Explore Jama Masjid, spice bazaars, wood-carving artisans, and sample authentic 7-course Kashmiri Wazwan.

experiences.name: Havelock Island Scuba & Coral Reef
experiences.desc: PADI-guided scuba dive along pristine coral gardens with turtles, rays, and tropical marine life.

experiences.name: Radhanagar Sunset & Mangrove Kayak
experiences.desc: Kayak through tranquil bio-rich mangrove creeks before taking in the golden sunset at Radhanagar Beach.

experiences.name: Old Delhi Spice Trail & Street Flavours
experiences.desc: Navigate Khari Baoli, Chandni Chowk street food gems, and historic Mughal lanes with a culinary insider.

experiences.name: Mughal Monuments & Heritage Walk
experiences.desc: Curated architectural walking tour of Humayun's Tomb, Sunder Nursery, and Nizamuddin Dargah.

experiences.name: South Mumbai Art Deco & Heritage Trail
experiences.desc: Discover UNESCO Victorian Gothic and Art Deco precincts around Oval Maidan and Marine Drive.

experiences.name: Coastal Seafood & Koli Village Trail
experiences.desc: Visit Sassoon Docks at dawn, explore a traditional Koli fishing enclave, and savour fresh Malvani seafood.

experiences.name: Garden City Walk & Heritage Coffee Trail
experiences.desc: Stroll Lalbagh Botanical Gardens, explore colonial cantonment history, and taste vintage filter coffee.

experiences.name: Charminar & Nizami Biryani Trail
experiences.desc: Evening heritage walk through Laad Bazaar to the Charminar, finishing with authentic Dum Biryani and Irani Chai.

experiences.name: Mylapore Heritage & Kapaleeshwarar Temple
experiences.desc: Experience 7th-century Dravidian architecture, sacred temple tank rituals, and classical Carnatic arts.

hotels.name: River Perch Resort
hotels.amenities: Yoga deck · River view · Organic meals
